remaining.weapon_equip: Saveword setter proven, but authoritative live weapon-object replacement lifecycle not fully validated. Stock edits allow obtaining weapons for normal game equipment menu.
remaining.level_lowering: Only monotonic native level advancement found. Character ability words contain ID/enabled, no reward provenance. Exact undo of earned abilities cannot be inferred from current save alone. Supported future semantics should explicitly retain rewards or restore prior backup; do not delete matching abilityIDs heuristically.
remaining.forms_unlock: Unique bit alone insufficient; grant handler looks up command and initializes weapon/anti-form EXP. Not included in uniquegrant until command/table/stock path is fully gated.
remaining.world_flags: Read layout and setter/script queue proven; no blind allflags unlock. World/room transition belongs world agent.

backups.raw: Capture69568 bytes plus gameSHA/version/timestamp/scene metadata on game thread
backups.disk: Back up actual Steam save container files separately; rawKH2J memory is not a drop-in container
backups.restore: Restore disk backup while gameclosed or load a prior save normally. Full liveSaveMemcpy does not refresh actorstatus/world scripts
backups.one_time_changes: Trainer disable/heartbeat reset cannot undo already modified game progression. Save backup first when desired.
